info.title: TraceTus API
info.description: Proof layer for origin, certification and custody records. Only hashes and references reach the network; a record is a leaf and a transaction is a batch. Every response carries the environment label. Every path lives under /v1, and within /v1 only additive changes are made: a new route, a new optional field. Every POST requires an Idempotency-Key.
